description: The widget's `touched` declared as a parameter property. TypeScript makes it a property of the class, and it is a parameter, not a property declaration: ngc refuses `input()` anywhere but a property's initializer (NG8110). The widget has no input `touched`, and point 3 says so and where the declaration that is none stands.
message: libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: PctWidget has no `touched`, only a declaration that is no member at libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts:28
